description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for Git blame corner cases, including various command-line options, file manipulations, and edge case scenarios. It sets up test repositories, executes Git blame commands with different parameters, and verifies the expected outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, running provided shell code and checking the results.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the command to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output, confirming its presence.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks that output has the expected number of lines.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to expected files.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.
